name: fluidvoice

description: Transcribe audio and video files or web media with the FluidVoice Local API
author: volkmar_eich

commands.name: transcribe-audio
commands.title: Transcribe Audio
commands.description: Transcribe a URL or local audio/video file
commands.subtitle: FluidVoice

commands.name: connection
commands.title: Check Connection
commands.description: Check the FluidVoice Local API version and connection
commands.subtitle: FluidVoice

tools.name: transcribe
tools.title: Transcribe Media
tools.description: Transcribe one audio/video URL, file URL, or absolute local file path using the speech model selected in FluidVoice. Downloads web media locally and returns the transcript for questions or summaries. FluidVoice must be running with Local API enabled.

preferences.name: fluidVoicePort
preferences.title: Local API Port
preferences.description: Port configured in FluidVoice Local API settings

preferences.name: retainedDownloads
preferences.title: Downloaded Files to Keep
preferences.description: Number of completed media downloads to keep; 0 deletes them after transcription. Original local files are never deleted.
